Name: GAMEDATA_UNLOCK_PARAM
Description: Unlock conditions for game data. Each row names a condition type and the ID checked to decide whether it is unlocked.

Fields.Name: Unlock Type
Fields.Description: The kind of unlock condition. Decides what Reference ID points to.

Fields.Name: Reference ID
Fields.Description: ID checked for the unlock. Its target depends on Unlock Type: a goods item, an event flag, an OS tuning point, a mercenary rank or a mission.
